description: 15 §4.6 End / kill (SP-14, OpenCode 1.18.32): a turn ended by POST /session/{id}/abort?directory=<cwd>, a POST with no body answered 200 true, after which the shared server stayed up. Its event stream: the person's prompt part is one person message, then busy is status working (the recorded order); session.error MessageAbortedError is the abort DwarfAI asked for, so it is no provider error; idle is status idle once (a repeated idle changes nothing); the aborted assistant message, completed with the counts it reported, is one sealed fidelity-1 usage observation (zero tokens, as reported: never an invented count). No turn.ended (turnEnd none until S-021-2).

record.text: Write the numbers from 1 to 300 as English words, one per line. Use no tools.
